kevin: Heads-up — I kicked off the staged publish for py+ts SDKs at 10:32 PT. Py wheels uploaded to staging, npm artifacts published to ephemeral tag. deploy-bot: Started release pipeline for ref: refs/heads/main @kevin — staged_publish_step1 started.
maria: saw the npm publish, thanks. quick ask: do we want to pin the legacy sync client in the stable tag before final cut? Some customers still relying on it.
sanjay: +1 on pinning. If we flip stable to drop sync unexpectedly we'll get a support spike. can we add a deprecation note in the CHANGELOG and leave a soft shim for one minor?
priya: Agree. Plan: 1) soft pin legacy sync to 0.9.x on stable channel, 2) publish new modular client as 1.0.0-rc on canary, 3) add deprecation blurb in release notes and docs.
kevin: That works. Operationally: who will handle the PyPI retag if checksum mismatch shows up? We had an earlier issue where sdist/whl diverged.
rachel: I can take PyPI validation and checksum check during the hold window. If any mismatch, we rollback npm tag and keep py on staging. I’ll run `twine check` + sha256 compare.
deploy-bot: staged_publish_step1: npm: publish to tag temp-2523456789 succeeded. py: wheel upload succeeded. integration tests queued.
maria: Also flagging telemetry — we saw a small perf regression in generator under 1024 seq in canary last night. If regressions show up in smoke, prefer to abort cut. add gating to block final promotion.
kevin: Good call. Add smoke_eval with the promptset 'smoke/latency-1024'. If p50 increases > 15% we abort. Samplestage command in the pipeline:
```
# smoke eval invocation
smoke_eval --suite smoke/latency-1024 --threshold 1.15 --on-fail abort
```
priya: For the pinning step, we should update the deprecation page and add a redirect in docs to the new `@redwood/sdk-client` package. I'll draft the copy and push a docs PR referencing the canary tag.
sanjay: For rollback decision: define clear cut criteria in thread: 1) checksum mismatch on artifacts -> immediate hold + republish attempt within 30m; 2) failing smoke tests or p50 > 15% -> abort promotion and notify customers; 3) publish bot 5xx during final push -> automatic retry once, then manual.
kevin: Agreed. Also we should include a temporary pin in the release metadata so downstream dependents that use `~` or `^` don't accidentally pick the breaking change. Add `legacy-sync: "<=0.9.4"` to the compat map for stable.
rachel: Quick note — PyPI backfill will require changing the tag on internal CDN, I'll coordinate with infra to invalidate caches if we have to yank.
deploy-bot: smoke_eval job started for suite smoke/latency-1024.
maria: smoke run looks clean so far, no perf regression in the first 100 samples.
kevin: Okay let's hold for the post-smoke window (10m) then promote canary->stable after docs PR merges. Everyone OK with final promotes at +15m?
priya: Yes. I'll open the docs PR now: PR #5623. will link in this thread when ready.
sanjay: I'll prepare rollback playbook snippet and paste in case we need fast revert.
rachel: If we need to yank npm tag, command: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary || true` then republish with `npm publish --tag canary`. For PyPI, `twine upload --skip-existing` and then yanked versions will need a new x.y.z+hotfix.
kevin: Thanks all. If no objections I'll hit final promote after the 10m hold and PR merge. @deploy-bot please post final status when promotion finishes.
deploy-bot: staged_publish_step1 -> promote_to_stable queued by kevin. If promotion fails, runbook: notify #support, tag @oncall-devex.
maria: thumbs up :thumbsup:
kevin: promoting now...
deploy-bot: promote_to_stable: npm tag update succeeded. py: wheel promoted to stable index succeeded. release metadata: {"stable": "1.0.0", "canary": "1.0.0-rc"}
sanjay: copying rollback playbook into support ticket in case.
rachel: docs PR merged, redirects in place.
kevin: closing thread — followups in #support if anything surfaces.
